nodes.title: SG-4.2 Extract scene build and character animation modules
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts (165 lines) still builds effects and scene objects, creates character sprites and animations, subscribes to playAnimation and syncs objects with the store. SG-4.1 already extracted phaser/preload.ts with createPreloader and dispose. Desired behavior: phaser/buildScene.ts and phaser/characters.ts create the layers, objects and character animations and return dispose functions, and BootScene delegates to them and calls both on SHUTDOWN. Expected result: the boys-room scene looks and plays the same. Why: it is the second step of splitting BootScene into a thin lifecycle shell.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a scene spec, When phaser/buildScene.ts is called, Then it returns the scene objects, the effect handles, a sync function and a dispose function
- Given a scene with characters, When phaser/characters.ts is called, Then it returns a dispose function and plays animations on playAnimation
- Given SHUTDOWN, When BootScene shuts down, Then both dispose functions are called and no tween, sprite, effect or bridge listener remains
- Given the existing bootScene* tests, When they run, Then they pass, rewritten against behaviour where they pinned internals


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/phaser/buildScene.ts
- In scope: game/frontend/src/phaser/characters.ts
- In scope: game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts delegation
- In scope: tests for build, characters and sync
- Out of scope: Transitions module and thin BootScene (SG-4.3)
- Out of scope: Asset preload module (SG-4.1, done)
- Out of scope: backend/ and the contribution/round API
- Out of scope: New features, content, art changes or juice
- Preserve: Player-visible scene, character animations, object focus and interaction, transitions
- Preserve: playSceneTransition and transitionTo behaviour
- Preserve: Zustand store as the only owner of GameState


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0; the phaser-pin guard test must keep passing
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No test is deleted or skipped; tests that pinned internals are rewritten against behaviour
- No source file in game/src or game/frontend/src over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- Tests mock only what is external


## Dependencies
- SG-4.1 phaser/preload.ts
- game/src/engine/buildScene.ts, buildEffects.ts, characterAnimation.ts


## Definition of done
- Both modules exist and return dispose functions
- BootScene delegates to them
- All tests and typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/


## Non-functional requirements
- No per-frame allocations added
- Textures, tweens and listeners released on shutdown


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · phaser/buildScene.ts builds layers, objects and effects, syncs with the store and disposes
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene.create builds effects with buildEffects and objects with engine buildScene, and onStateChange/applyFocusedObject sync them. Desired behavior: one module returns { objects, effects, effectContext, sync, dispose }. Expected result: the scene shows the same objects, and sync applies GameState and focused object id; dispose destroys objects and effects. Why: BootScene becomes a lifecycle shell.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a scene and sceneSpec, When createSceneBuild runs, Then objects equal engine buildScene output and effects equal buildEffects output
- Given state and focusedObjectId 'bed', When sync runs, Then every object receives sync(state) and only the object with spec.id 'bed' is focused
- Given focusedObjectId null, When sync runs, Then every focused object is blurred
- Given dispose, When called, Then every object is destroyed and destroyEffects runs once


## Scope
- In scope: new phaser/buildScene.ts
- Out of scope: character sprites
- Out of scope: transitions
- Preserve: Layer depths and focus behaviour


## Technical constraints
- Phaser pinned ~3.90.0
- Files under 200 lines
- game/src must not import game/frontend


## Dependencies
- game/src/engine/buildScene.ts
- game/src/engine/buildEffects.ts
- phaser/effectContext.ts
- phaser/renderContext.ts


## Definition of done
- Module exports createSceneBuild with sync and dispose


## Non-functional requirements
- No per-frame allocation


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · phaser/characters.ts creates characters and animations, plays playAnimation and disposes
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene holds ensureAnim, createCharacter, playCharacterAnimation and the playAnimation subscription. Desired behavior: move them into one module returning { sprites, play, dispose }. Expected result: idle, interact and walk animations look identical; clicking a character plays interact then idle; dispose destroys sprites and unsubscribes. Why: character animation gets its own module.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given scene.characters, When createCharacters runs, Then one sprite per spec is added and idle is played when the manifest has the animation
- Given a playAnimation event for a known id and 'interact', When emitted, Then interact plays and idle is queued on ANIMATION_COMPLETE
- Given an unknown id or name, When emitted, Then nothing plays
- Given dispose, When called, Then sprites are destroyed and the playAnimation listener is removed


## Scope
- In scope: new phaser/characters.ts
- Out of scope: scene objects
- Out of scope: transitions
- Preserve: Animation keys `${asset}:${animation}`
- Preserve: characterClick via inputLayer.bindCharacter


## Technical constraints
- Phaser pinned ~3.90.0
- Files under 200 lines
- game/src must not import game/frontend


## Dependencies
- game/src/engine/characterAnimation.ts
- phaser/input.ts bindCharacter
- phaser/events.ts


## Definition of done
- Module exports createCharacters returning dispose


## Non-functional requirements
- Anims created once per key


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · BootScene delegates build and characters and disposes both on SHUTDOWN
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene still contains the logic. Desired behavior: create() calls createSceneBuild and createCharacters, onStateChange calls build.sync, SHUTDOWN calls both dispose functions. Expected result: scene behaves the same and old private methods are gone. Why: the Done-when requires modules wired into the real entry point.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given BootScene.create, When it runs, Then it calls createSceneBuild and createCharacters and passes build objects to createInputLayer
- Given a store change, When it fires, Then build.sync runs with the state and focusedObjectId
- Given SHUTDOWN, When emitted, Then build.dispose and characters.dispose are each called once
- Given the old code, When viewed, Then ensureAnim, createCharacter, playCharacterAnimation and applyFocusedObject no longer exist in BootScene


## Scope
- In scope: BootScene.ts
- Out of scope: transitionTo handler move
- Preserve: Event order: sceneReady emitted, playSceneTransition called after first sync

- Phaser pinned ~3.90.0
- BootScene under 200 lines

- REQ2


## Definition of done
- BootScene delegates, tests pass

nodes.summary: Add the scene build module with sync and dispose
nodes.description: Create game/frontend/src/phaser/buildScene.ts moving the effect and object creation and the store sync out of BootScene.
acceptance_criteria: createSceneBuild returns objects, effects, effectContext, sync and dispose
dispose destroys objects and effects and empties them

steps.action: Create createSceneBuild(scene: Phaser.Scene, resolveKey: (id: string) => string, content: SceneDef-like `scene`, spec: SceneSpec): SceneBuild. Inside: ctx = createPhaserEffectContext(scene, resolveKey); effects = buildEffects(ctx, content); objects = buildEngineScene(createPhaserRenderContext(scene, resolveKey), spec) (import engine buildScene as buildEngineScene). Return effectContext: ctx.
steps.code: export type SceneBuild = { objects: SceneObject[]; effects: EffectHandle[]; effectContext: ReturnType<typeof createPhaserEffectContext>; sync(state: GameState, focusedId: string | null): void; dispose(): void };
steps.expected: Module compiles and exports the SceneBuild type and createSceneBuild

steps.action: Implement sync(state, focusedId): objects.forEach(o => o.sync(state)); then objects.forEach: if focusedId !== null && o.spec.id === focusedId call o.focus() when !o.isFocused, else call o.blur() when o.isFocused (copy of BootScene.applyFocusedObject).
steps.expected: Sync applies state and focus exactly as BootScene did

steps.action: Implement dispose(): destroyEffects(effects); effects.length = 0; objects.forEach(o => o.destroy()); objects.length = 0.
steps.expected: Calling dispose destroys all handles; second call is a no-op

nodes.description: Edit BootScene.ts so create() uses createSceneBuild and createCharacters, onStateChange calls sync, SHUTDOWN calls both dispose.
acceptance_criteria: Old private methods removed
SHUTDOWN disposes both modules
Unused imports removed

steps.action: Replace fields effects, sceneObjects, characterSprites, characterAnims, unsubscribeAnimation with `private build: SceneBuild | null = null;` and `private characters: Characters | null = null;`. Keep unsubscribe, preloader, unsubscribeTransition, inputLayer.

Replace effect/object/character construction with: this.build = createSceneBuild(this, key, scene, sceneSpec); const ctx = this.build.effectContext; this.inputLayer = createInputLayer(this.input, this.build.objects); this.characters = createCharacters(this, scene.characters ?? [], manifest, key, this.inputLayer); where key = (id) => this.resolveKey(id). Remove the playAnimation subscription. In SHUTDOWN call this.build?.dispose(); this.characters?.dispose(); and null both; keep the other releases.
steps.expected: Create wires modules; shutdown disposes both

steps.action: Delete ensureAnim, createCharacter, playCharacterAnimation and applyFocusedObject. Change onStateChange to: const state = this.readState(); if (!state) return; this.build?.sync(state, useGameStore.getState().focusedObjectId). Remove now-unused imports (buildEffects, destroyEffects, EffectHandle, buildScene, createPhaserRenderContext, resolveCharacterAnimation, layerDepth, AnimationDef, SceneObject, CharacterSpec); add imports of createSceneBuild/SceneBuild and createCharacters/Characters.
steps.expected: npm run typecheck passes in game/frontend
